info.title: AI Accelerator Hub API
info.description: Every route handler of the platform, generated from the route files (docs/API_DOCS_SPEC.md). Calls from this page use your own signed-in session, so they act as you. Changes (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) are real.
